theme: payload size gate LENALL MINMAX bag ZIP soft oversize

tests.name: ingest_measure
tests.cmd: ingest 4 payloads; measure → sizes 2,5,1,10 + ZIP labeled

tests.name: gate_oversize
tests.cmd: gate thresh5 max10 soft rc0; REQUIRE EXIT 2; gate 20 under

tests.name: pin_drop
tests.cmd: pin fat payload; drop x; drop ghost REQUIRE

tests.name: zip_pad_minmax_empty
tests.cmd: ZIP pad empty partner; MIN/MAX empty bag → 0

tests.name: zip_sep_var
tests.cmd: SYS ZIP a b sep → unknown form sep
tests.note: same bare-ident form steal as CHUNK

weaknesses.title: MIN/MAX empty bag returns 0 without FAIL
weaknesses.detail: SYS MAX "" → LAST_N=0 looks like a real max of zero. Agents gating on empty sizes plate may pass falsely if they forget BLANK/LINES check.
weaknesses.repro: MAX "" → 0; COUNT==0 metadata only if checked

weaknesses.title: No LENWHERE / filter fields by length threshold
weaknesses.detail: fat action rebuilds via EACH sizes + NTH bag index. O(n) glue and index desync if bags diverge. Common ops need keep-if-len>=N.

weaknesses.title: ZIP join sep bare var → unknown form
weaknesses.detail: SYS ZIP a b sep with LET sep="=" fails form-steal. Same class as CHUNK/WINDOW join seps.
weaknesses.repro: LET sep="="; SYS ZIP x y sep

weaknesses.title: ZIP unequal length pads empty — silent mispair
weaknesses.detail: ZIP three payloads with two sizes yields trailing ':'. Agents measure after drop without re-measure get wrong labels.

weaknesses.title: LENALL is char/code-unit length not display width
weaknesses.detail: No UTF-8/byte/display modes documented for multi-byte payloads. Ops size gates may under/over count.

weaknesses.title: LENALL/MIN/MAX/ZIP non-mutate
weaknesses.detail: Must LET sizes/labeled = LAST or WRITE stale.
weaknesses.repro: LENALL bag; WRITE sizes bag still payloads

weaknesses.title: Payload fields with colon break ZIP labeled plate
weaknesses.detail: ZIP default ':' sep; body containing ':' makes AFTER peel ambiguous for reverse parse.

workarounds: Always BLANK/LINES sizes before MIN/MAX; never treat max==0 as authoritative alone
Re-measure after any drop/pin that changes bag order or membership
ZIP with default colon only on colon-free ids; use ids not raw bodies for keys
Hardcode SYS ZIP a b "=" if custom sep; no var sep
language_gaps: LENWHERE / keep fields by length predicate
MIN/MAX empty → soft fail or NaN-like sticky
UTF-8 byte length mode for LENALL
ZIP safe encoding when key contains sep
issues_faced: Empty MAX=0 is a silent gate footgun — documented W1
fat requires index walk; no host form for length filter
ZIP sep var confirmed unknown form
